# Run book: Convert and store a document

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/convert-a-document.md) | [Spec](../specs/convert-a-document.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Convert and store documents (text, HTML, PDF, markdown) behind one service, so callers never depend on a converter library.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Convert and store a document"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/content/documents`:

1. **Choose a file.** Pick the file to work with; every action below uses it. Expect: The Convert button is enabled once a file is chosen.
2. **Convert it.** Choose the target type and convert. The converted text appears below. Expect: The converted text appears in the result panel.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conversion shows a binary placeholder | The target type is not text | Use the Download or PDF links for binary results |
| Upload does nothing | The store name is empty | Enter a name in store before uploading |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Documents.
